testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect a selected minimization policy while the full ribbon is open: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:89:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect a selected minimization policy while the full ribbon is open ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the full Tools ribbon is visible ✔ And Minimize to Tabs is the selected ribbon display policy ✔ When the user opens the ribbon display policy menu ✔ Then Minimize to Tabs is marked as selected ✔ And Minimize to Panel Titles, Minimize to Panel Buttons and Cycle Through All are listed ✔ And the full Tools ribbon remains visible ✔ When the user dismisses the menu with Escape ✔ Then the menu closes without changing the display policy ✔ And the full Tools ribbon remains visible
